title: NovaraMC
description: NovaraMC is a community-focused survival server where players are free to build, explore, and play at their own pace.
body:
NovaraMC is a community-focused survival server where players are free to build, explore, and play at their own pace. Enjoy a balanced SMP experience with optional PvP, quality-of-life features, and a friendly environment designed for long-term gameplay.

The server is currently self-hosted. My Internet might be cutting out. It will automatically renew the IP, but I need to update it manually.
